gripOrHq.title: Loan from Chiba
gripOrHq.rulesText: Gain [12] when Loan from Chiba is installed. At the start of each of your turns, lose [1]. If Loan from Chiba leaves play, pay [10] or lose the game. You may trash Loan from Chiba at the end of any of your turns.

gripOrHq.title: Startup Immolator
gripOrHq.rulesText: [T]: Pay the rez cost of a piece of ice to trash that piece of ice. Use this ability only if you have just broken all the subroutines of that piece of ice.

gripOrHq.title: Core Command: Jettison Ice
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Pay the rez cost of a piece of rezzed ice to trash it.

scoreArea.title: Project Venice
scoreArea.rulesText: For every three advancement counters over Project Venice 's difficulty that are on Project Venice when you score it, gain an action during each of your turns.

scoreArea.title: Charity Takeover
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [9] and 1 Bad Publicity point. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

scoreArea.title: Marked Accounts
scoreArea.rulesText: When Runner accesses Marked Accounts, give Runner a tag, even if it is not installed. If Marked Accounts is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

rig.title: Junkyard BBS
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

rig.title: Restrictive Net Zoning
rig.rulesText: Choose a data fort when Restrictive Net Zoning is installed. The Corp must pay [2], in addition to the normal cost, to install ice on that fort.

rig.title: Broker
rig.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

scoreArea.title: Project Zurich
scoreArea.rulesText: For every two advancement counters over Project Zurich 's difficulty that are on Project Zurich when you score it, gain 1 at the start of each of your turns.

ice.title: Chihuahua
ice.rulesText: *Trace 1-If trace is successful, do 1 Net damage. Gain [2] when you rez Chihuahua.

ice.title: Bug Zapper
ice.rulesText: *Do 2 Net damage for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside Bug Zapper. *End the run.

ice.title: Galatea
ice.rulesText: *End the run. When you rez Galatea, you may pay [1], above the rez cost, to make it a code gate instead of a wall.
